specification fp32_forward_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (R : SumPrimitive α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α)
    (hmy : p.mean ≠ p.y) (hmr : p.mean ≠ p.rstd) (hry : p.rstd ≠ p.y) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec (withSum M R) (kernel p) s = some t ∧
      t.mem = (reference M R p s).mem ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [p.block], i.1.val < p.columns →
        t.mem p.y (outputOffset p s i) = stored M (yValue M R p s i)) ∧
      t.mem p.mean (meanOffset p s) = stored M (meanValue M R p s) ∧
      t.mem p.rstd (rstdOffset p s) = stored M (rstdValue M R p s) ∧
      (∀ r o, Outside p s r o → t.mem r o = s.mem r o)

specification fp32_scalarops_forward_correctness [Inhabited (FP.Value .fp32)]
    (rest : Algebra (FP.Value .fp32)) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (literal : ℝ → FP.Value .fp32) (rsqrt32 : FP.Value .fp32 → FP.Value .fp32)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State (FP.Value .fp32))
    (hmy : p.mean ≠ p.y) (hmr : p.mean ≠ p.rstd) (hry : p.rstd ≠ p.y) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec (withSum (software rest cfg literal rsqrt32) (softwareSum cfg))
      (kernel p) s = some t ∧
      (∀ i : TileIndex [p.block], i.1.val < p.columns →
        t.mem p.y (outputOffset p s i) = .mk .fp32 (bitY cfg literal rsqrt32 p s i)) ∧
      t.mem p.mean (meanOffset p s) = .mk .fp32 (bitMean cfg literal p s) ∧
      t.mem p.rstd (rstdOffset p s) = .mk .fp32 (bitRstd cfg literal rsqrt32 p s) ∧
      (∀ r o, Outside p s r o → t.mem r o = s.mem r o)

specification supplied_mean_store_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (pre output : RegionName) (stride : Nat) (s : State α) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (meanStore .fp32 pre output stride) s = some t ∧
      t.mem output (s.pids 0*stride) = .mk .fp32 ((s.mem pre (s.pids 0*stride)).read .fp32) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ output ∨ o ≠ s.pids 0*stride) → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification supplied_rstd_store_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α] (M : Algebra α)
    (pre output : RegionName) (stride : Nat) (s : State α) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (rstdStore .fp32 pre output stride) s = some t ∧
      t.mem output (s.pids 0*stride) = .mk .fp32 ((s.mem pre (s.pids 0*stride)).read .fp32) ∧
      (∀ r o, (r ≠ output ∨ o ≠ s.pids 0*stride) → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification fp32_full_stream_correctness {α : Type} [Inhabited α]
    (M : Algebra α) (p : Parameters) (s : State α)
    (hb : 0<p.block) (hx : p.x ≠ p.y) (hw : p.weight ≠ p.y) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec M (kernel p) s=some t ∧
      t.mem=referenceMem M p s ∧
      (∀ n, n<p.columns → t.mem p.y (yBase p s+n)=.mk .fp32 (yValue M p s n)) ∧
      (∀ r o, Outside p s r o → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification fp32_scalarops_full_stream_correctness [Inhabited (FP.Value .fp32)]
    (rest : Algebra (FP.Value .fp32)) (cfg : FP.Config)
    (literal : ℝ → FP.Value .fp32) (sqrt32 : FP.Value .fp32 → FP.Value .fp32)
    (p : Parameters) (s : State (FP.Value .fp32))
    (hb : 0<p.block) (hx : p.x ≠ p.y) (hw : p.weight ≠ p.y) :
    ∃ t, FP.Structural.exec (software rest cfg literal sqrt32) (kernel p) s=some t ∧
      (∀ n, n<p.columns → t.mem p.y (yBase p s+n)=.mk .fp32 (bitY cfg literal sqrt32 p s n)) ∧
      (∀ r o, Outside p s r o → t.mem r o=s.mem r o)

specification layer_norm_liger_forward_output_summary
    (Y X W B Mean RSTD : RegionName)
    (Y_row_stride X_row_stride W_row_stride B_row_stride
      Mean_row_stride RSTD_row_stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE : Nat)
    (eps : ℝ) (s : BlockState)
    (hYMean : Y ≠ Mean) (hYRSTD : Y ≠ RSTD)
    (hMeanY : Mean ≠ Y) (hMeanRSTD : Mean ≠ RSTD)
    (hRSTDY : RSTD ≠ Y)
    (hOutInj : Function.Injective
      (fun i : Fin BLOCK_SIZE => yOffset s Y_row_stride i)) :
    (∃ alg, (layer_norm_liger_forward_surface Y Y_row_stride X
      X_row_stride W W_row_stride B B_row_stride Mean Mean_row_stride RSTD
      RSTD_row_stride n_cols eps BLOCK_SIZE).toAlgorithm? = Except.ok alg) ∧
    ((ComputeCorrect.Realizes_without_Rounding
      (kernel := layer_norm_liger_forward Y X W B Mean RSTD Y_row_stride
        X_row_stride Mean_row_stride RSTD_row_stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE eps)
      (initialState := s)
      (write := ComputeCorrect.WriteMap.writeIf
        (fun i : Fin BLOCK_SIZE => i.val < n_cols)
        (fun i => (Y, yOffset s Y_row_stride i)))
      (expected := fun i =>
        layernormYSpec s X W B X_row_stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE eps i)) ∧
    (ComputeCorrect.Realizes_without_Rounding
      (kernel := layer_norm_liger_forward Y X W B Mean RSTD Y_row_stride
        X_row_stride Mean_row_stride RSTD_row_stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE eps)
      (initialState := s)
      (write := fun _ : PUnit => some (Mean, s.pid * Mean_row_stride))
      (expected := fun _ =>
        WithBot.unbotD 0
          (layernormMeanCarrier s X X_row_stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE))) ∧
    (ComputeCorrect.Realizes_without_Rounding
      (kernel := layer_norm_liger_forward Y X W B Mean RSTD Y_row_stride
        X_row_stride Mean_row_stride RSTD_row_stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE eps)
      (initialState := s)
      (write := fun _ : PUnit => some (RSTD, s.pid * RSTD_row_stride))
      (expected := fun _ =>
        WithBot.unbotD 0
          (layernormInvVarCarrier s X X_row_stride n_cols BLOCK_SIZE eps))))

compile.mode: direct lake env lean -o; isolated imports; no lake build

layer_norm_liger.covered: Complete per-row forward: typed X/W/B loads, full-block sum, mean division, all padded centered squares, full-block variance reduction, epsilon add, rsqrt, both scalar Mean/RSTD stores, affine Y and masked fp32 store; separately supplied MeanPre and RSTDPre copy stages.
layer_norm_liger.domain: Arbitrary block, columns, epsilon, row and original address strides. All source lanes retained. Full three-output readback assumes Mean!=Y, Mean!=RSTD, RSTD!=Y, equivalent to the original output-separation requirements. Output-offset injectivity is proved from the actual contiguous column offset; no extra numerical assumption.
layer_norm_liger.padding: A padded X=+0 lane still computes (0-mean)^2. This is not replaced by a live-column sum. Checked concrete witness has N=2, B=4, live X=[1,1], mean=1, variance=1 due to the two padded terms.
layer_norm_liger.strides: Y/X/Mean/RSTD row strides used exactly; W_row_stride and B_row_stride remain signature parameters but are unused, matching Python.
layer_norm_liger.independent_supplied_stages: MeanPre/RSTDPre stores each have independent successful execution, exact typed-cell readback and frame. Neither supplied scalar is assumed to equal the full-forward computed statistic.
layer_norm_liger.excluded: Python backward, host launch/grid composition, other storage dtypes and native hardware conformance.

layernorm_fwd_triton.covered: Complete arbitrary-N three-pass stream: positive-zero lane accumulators; every mean-loop masked load/cast/add; full-lane sum and division; every variance-loop masked load, where, square and add; full-lane sum and division; epsilon/sqrt/reciprocal; every output-loop X/W load/cast, centered normalization, multiply, final typed masked store; every n<N output and full frame.
layernorm_fwd_triton.domain: B>0, X!=Y, W!=Y; arbitrary N including zero, all original sequence/head strides and program ids. The source memory theorem works for all typed initial cells; original extent/layout/IO safety declarations remain unchanged and their legal domain is included. No new typed IO skin or host composition proof is claimed.
layernorm_fwd_triton.padding: Variance uses the actual where(cols<N,x-mean,0) before square. Zero-square and zero-add tail operations remain. Output W masked load has no other; its address-dependent undef value and subsequent arithmetic remain before the final masked store.
layernorm_fwd_triton.strides: Sequence/head strides used exactly; stride_x_hd, stride_y_hd and stride_w_hd are unused parameters, as in Python.
layernorm_fwd_triton.excluded: Backward, host launch/layout composition, other storage dtypes and native hardware conformance.

scope.source_bridge: All complete-source dtype-erasure/control bridges pass, including both supplied scalar slices. Liger explicit denominator fp32 conversion materializes Python implicit scalar promotion; explicit final .to(DTYPE) materializes pointer-store conversion lost by pointer rebinding in the existing frontend. No shared source changed; erasure is not claimed value preserving.

numerical_model.parameterized: Arbitrary opaque alpha values and per-operation Algebra callbacks. Liger additionally requires total typed full-tile SumPrimitive for the initial fp32 sum. No algebraic equality, exact-rounding identity or assumed final result.
numerical_model.scalarops: FP.Value.fp32 with ScalarOps per add/sub/mul/div, arbitrary Config, explicit ascending-lane sequential reductions with +0 seed; all exposed values independent of unused rest callbacks. rsqrt (Liger), sqrt (stream), and conversion of nontrivial source literals remain explicit bindings.
numerical_model.not_a_closed_bit_interpreter: The scalar arithmetic is bit accurate, but sqrt/rsqrt and nontrivial literals are callbacks. Both scalarops public claims are backend_value_contract, not closed native or closed bit-interpreter correctness.
numerical_model.reduction_plans: Liger full BLOCK_SIZE sum and variance tree; stream lanes accumulate across every range iteration then each full BLOCK_SIZE lane vector is reduced. The concrete software plan is ascending-lane +0-seeded rounded-add, not asserted equal to the GPU tree.

witnesses.liger_nonempty_rounding: N=2,B=4, live X=[1,2^-25], padded tail; actual full-source execution for any supplied rsqrt callback writes Mean=0.5, distinct from exact (1+2^-25)/2; inactive Y[2] preserved.
witnesses.liger_padding: For live X=[1,1], N=2,B=4, the actual full padded variance is 1, not 0; checked by kernel reduction.
witnesses.stream_nonempty_rounding: N=3,B=2, X=[1,2^-25,1]; all three loops run twice including tail. Actual successful source run gives all 3 software outputs for the explicit sqrt callback and preserves Y[3]. Internal fp32 mean is bits 0x3f2aaaab (11184811/16777216), different from exact (2+2^-25)/3.
witnesses.method: decide +kernel, no native_decide; actual complete_run witnesses used, not source=source equivalence.

native_obligations.bind: Actual X/W/B/Y/Mean/RSTD fp32 storage for Liger, X/W/Y fp32 for stream; typed memory loads/stores and erased fp32 carrier casts preserve bits. Liger local test lines254-256 and output allocations lines152-154; stream local test dtype float32. Other dtype calls are outside this profile.

Exact integer-N to fp32 scalar promotion and source epsilon/literal conversion for each invocation; +0 and 1 fixed in software, other literals supplied explicitly. The Liger denominator cast materializes that conversion; native binding is still required.

Bind exact architecture/compiler instruction for Liger tl.rsqrt and stream tl.sqrt plus reciprocal division; precision/approximation, nonfinite behavior, FTZ, signed zero and NaN policy. No Real.sqrt/Real.rsqrt substitute or generic accuracy law is used.

Pin Triton/compiler/CUDA/architecture, PTX/cubin/flags, rounding/FTZ/NaN conventions. Software arithmetic is separately rounded add/sub/mul/div; actual fusion/reciprocal approximation must match or require a revised operation graph.
Pin each layout/numWarps/BLOCK_SIZE-specific tree, seed and leaf order for both sum reductions. The sequential software plan is explicit and has no claimed GPU tree equivalence.

Preserve Liger padded centered-square terms, stream masked centering and W undefined padding behavior, all source address formulas and unchanged original extent/layout constraints; host launch and cross-program composition remain outside per-program contract.
